thread:
Maria: Quick heads-up — Valencia Health (enterprise) wants to run a short POC next month. They have strict identity requirements: SSO via SAML, SCIM for user + group sync, RBAC mapping to AD groups, and domain-level proofing (multiple subdomains). They also asked about audit logs, KMS for keys, and an ops runbook. Need answers so I can reply to their security/compliance lead.

Priya: Copy. Do we already have a recommended SCIM attribute mapping for their AD? they asked about `employeeNumber` -> external_id and department -> group mapping.

Alex: We support mapping arbitrary SCIM attributes to Redwood roles. For Valencia I'd recommend mapping `employeeNumber` to `external_id` and using `groups` for RBAC. Example SCIM payload we usually send in the POC: ```{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "j.ramirez@valencia.health",
  "externalId": "12345",
  "name": {"givenName":"Jose","familyName":"Ramirez"},
  "emails": [{"value":"j.ramirez@valencia.health","primary":true}],
  "groups": [{"value":"ops","display":"Ops"}]
}``` This handles idempotent upserts.

Sam: On bulk sync: our SCIM implementation handles incremental PATCH and full replace. We recommend PATCH for the POC to keep delta times small. For large orgs we can throttle and report back sync stats to the console.

Jordan: Security checklist: they asked for SOC2, KMS/HSM, audit retention 365 days, and domain proofing. We can provide SOC2 attestation doc and integrate customer-managed keys (bring-your-own KMS) on Private/Dedicated. Hosted supports platform-managed KMS only — call that out in the reply. Also: we require TXT DNS or file-based proof for domain verification; MX alone isn't sufficient.

Casey: RBAC detail — we map SCIM groups to roles. The mapping lives in the Console under Settings > Identity > Role mappings; you can set precedence (group -> role -> permissions). For POC, we can pre-create three roles (viewer, editor, admin) and map a test AD group to each.

Luis: Question on pricing and entitlements from sales: Valencia wants to know the delta between Hosted (with VDR and access controls) vs Dedicated reserved pool (monthly commit) for predictable latency. Also they asked if SCIM/user-sync is charged separately or part of seat/unit pricing.

Priya: From pricing — SCIM is included for enterprise plans; Dedicated is an add-on with monthly commit. We should give them two options: 1) short Hosted POC (30d) with usage billing + limited data residency; 2) Dedicated trial (30d discounted commit) if they care about strict isolation and KMS. I can draft numbers once engineering confirms any extra infra needs.

Maria: Also — their security team attached a questionnaire (30+ items). I started filling basics but flagged items we need: 1) KMS support details 2) Where audit logs are stored and export formats 3) SCIM rate limits and retry behavior 4) Data residency for tokens.

Jordan: I'll take the security Q. Need a copy of their questionnaire; Maria, can you drop that here or point to the shared drive? For SCIM rate limits: default is 120 reqs/min per customer on Hosted, negotiable for Dedicated. Retry: exponential backoff with jitter.

Alex: For POC test accounts I need 5-7 representative users: one admin, two editors, two viewers. Also request a sandbox IdP (SAML metadata or an Okta trial org) and a small CSV of users + groups. We can stand up the SAML Service Provider metadata in <24h once we have their metadata.

Maria: Uploading the questionnaire now: https://redwood.box/valencia-security-questionnaire.xlsx  — Valencia security also wants an on-call rotation contact and an escalation path.

Sam: For the ops runbook I'll prepare a short doc: SCIM sync steps, SAML test checklist, how to verify role mapping, and common failure modes (incorrect NameID format, clock skew). Will link it here in 24h.

Casey: Proposed POC timeline: Week 0 — exchange metadata + test accounts; Week 1 — SAML auth + SCIM sync validation; Week 2 — role mapping + audit/log validation; Week 3 — wrap-up and exec demo. If they want Dedicated trial we'll need procurement lead time for GPU-ish infra but we can still do an isolated test environment.

Maria: Great. Action items: 
- Maria: collect their SAML metadata + CSV and push questionnaire link (done)
- Alex: prepare SP metadata and SCIM mapping template (ETA 24h)
- Sam: ops runbook + sync guidance (ETA 24h)
- Jordan: fill security Q (ETA 48h)
- Casey/Priya: draft pricing options and note KMS differences (ETA 48h)

Priya: I'll draft the outbound reply to Valencia with options and attach the POC plan. Maria — shall I include a note about potential extra charges for extended audit retention beyond 365 days?

Maria: Yes please mention it and link them to the retention pricing doc. Also ask if they need HIPAA BAAs — they flagged healthcare concerns.

Luis: One more engineering note — for domain proof we support wildcard subdomain verification for the same org (TXT on root + DKIM style if needed). If Valencia uses delegated domains across tenants we'll need a slightly different onboarding flow.

Alex: FYI — common SAML gotcha: NameID formats. Valencia should use email (persistent) NameID or send `eduPersonPrincipalName`. We'll put that in the SP metadata docs.

Maria: Thanks all — I'll consolidate replies and send to Valencia security tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

Jordan: Ping me if they want to do an architecture call with their InfoSec. Happy to join.

Priya: I'll post the draft message in #sales-drafts for review before sending.

Alex: Uploaded SP metadata + SCIM template here: https://redwood.box/valencia-sp-scim.zip

Sam: Ops runbook draft: https://redwood.box/valencia-ops-runbook.md — feedback welcome.

Maria: Closing loop — will update this thread after Valencia replies.
